name: card
title: Card
description: Card that groups content with an optional title, description, body, and footer.

props.name: title
props.description: Card title, rendered as an h3.

props.name: footer
props.description: Action area at the bottom of the card, such as buttons.

a11y: Uses the article element, so the card reads as one self-contained piece of content.
The title is an h3. Adjust the page heading structure if the card sits directly under an h1.
No JavaScript and no built-in interactive elements.

ai.whenToUse: Grouping related information, such as a plan summary, a profile, or a statistic.
rules: Never make the whole card clickable, put links or buttons in the footer
Never nest a Card inside another Card
Cards use a border, not a shadow

id.description: Kartu untuk mengelompokkan konten dengan judul, deskripsi, isi, dan footer opsional.

props.title: Judul kartu, dirender sebagai h3.
props.footer: Area aksi di bagian bawah kartu, misalnya tombol.

a11y: Memakai elemen article, jadi kartu terbaca sebagai satu kesatuan konten.
Judul memakai h3. Sesuaikan struktur heading halaman bila kartu berada di bawah h1 langsung.
Tanpa JavaScript dan tanpa elemen interaktif bawaan.

ai.whenToUse: Mengelompokkan informasi yang saling terkait, misalnya ringkasan paket, profil, atau statistik.
rules: Jangan membuat seluruh kartu bisa diklik, taruh link atau tombol di footer
Jangan menumpuk Card di dalam Card
Kartu tidak memakai bayangan, cukup border
